stories.new_fact: A federal judge ruled the Trump administration's plan to cut FEMA staffing by 50 percent was unlawful.
stories.new_takeaway: Disaster readiness now turns on remedies, staffing instructions, and whether lost institutional knowledge can be rebuilt.
stories.why_now: The ruling was issued Saturday night and AP published the update Sunday.
stories.previous_coverage: No prior episode in the comparison set covered FEMA staffing cuts.
stories.uncertainty: The parties still have to negotiate the remedy; the ruling does not automatically restore every lost role.
stories.watch: Remedy talks, hiring or recalls, and any congressional staffing-planning requirement.

stories.new_fact: Iranian media reported one death and three injuries after a commercial ship was struck near Qeshm Island in the Strait of Hormuz.
stories.new_takeaway: The oil-risk question is now commercial behavior around vessels, not only missile interceptions or crude headlines.
stories.why_now: The ship-strike report and maritime confirmation were Sunday developments.
stories.previous_coverage: Previous scripts covered Gulf escalation and oil risk, but not this vessel-strike fact.
stories.uncertainty: It is unclear whether UKMTO's vessel report refers to the same incident and whether more attacks will follow.
stories.watch: Reroutes, insurance pricing, naval escorts, and repeated vessel strikes.

stories.new_fact: House Speaker Mike Johnson said Trump's proposed $5,000 dividend checks would require congressional approval.
stories.new_takeaway: The proposal is campaign politics until legislative text, funding, and coalition support exist.
stories.why_now: Johnson's Sunday comments clarified authority after Trump's pledge.
stories.previous_coverage: Not covered in the prior seven scripts.
stories.uncertainty: No enacted bill, funding plan, or distribution schedule exists.
stories.watch: Whether a bill is introduced and whether Republicans agree on offsets or deficit effects.

stories.new_fact: Ohio State said it disagrees with the ACLU's analysis of the campus chalking ban, while the ACLU says it is prepared to file a lawsuit.
stories.new_takeaway: The local issue is public-institution enforcement consistency, not merely a student-expression skirmish.
stories.why_now: The WOSU report was published September 11, within the 48-hour window for the September 13 episode.
stories.previous_coverage: No prior episode in the comparison set covered the OSU chalking dispute.
stories.uncertainty: The ACLU has threatened litigation but has not yet filed the cited lawsuit.
stories.watch: A complaint, injunction request, or university policy revision.

stories.new_fact: Mortgage News Daily showed 30-year fixed rates above seven percent while Freddie Mac's weekly survey still showed 6.76 percent.
stories.new_takeaway: The workflow consequence is lock-desk triage for active purchase files whose daily quotes diverged from the weekly public survey.
stories.why_now: The daily rate update was dated September 11 and remains the actionable Sunday/Monday pipeline issue.
stories.previous_coverage: Recent episodes covered rates and VantageScore; this is a different takeaway about daily pricing versus weekly survey lag.
stories.uncertainty: Daily surveys can change quickly and lender-specific pricing may differ.
stories.watch: 10-year Treasury, MBS spreads, lock expirations, and post-Fed lender pricing.

stories.new_fact: Rogo said Citi, Barclays, BNP Paribas, MUFG, and Societe Generale joined as strategic investors and that its platform is used across investment banking, wealth management, and asset management.
stories.new_takeaway: The bank-AI signal is real buyer interest in research copilots, but no task-level quality or productivity baseline has been disclosed.
stories.why_now: It is a previously uncovered specialist update from the last seven days and adds a new ledger row.
stories.previous_coverage: Prior bank AI segments covered Better, OpenAI financial services, Truist, and FIS; Rogo has not been covered.
stories.uncertainty: The source is a company claim and does not disclose audited bank outcomes.
stories.watch: Named bank production scope, entitlement controls, audited quality metrics, or compliance review results.
stories.date_exception: Sunday was quieter for fresh bank-AI disclosures; this September 10 specialist update changes the ledger and is operationally relevant.

stories.new_fact: Trump downplayed checks on AI development after AI leaders called for slowing frontier progress so safety measures can catch up.
stories.new_takeaway: The immediate frontier issue is whether safety concerns turn into enforceable lab policy, voluntary commitments, or unchanged acceleration.
stories.why_now: AP published Trump's response Sunday, following Amodei's Saturday warning.
stories.previous_coverage: Previous frontier episodes covered model launches, misuse, and trusted access; this advances the policy/control thread.
stories.uncertainty: The extreme agent-swarm scenario is a lab-executive warning, not independently measured public evidence.
stories.watch: Government rulemaking, lab evaluator access, voluntary pacts, and any bank-facing changes to model access or pricing.
stories.frontier_bar: Policy that binds labs directly and safety/security findings.

stories.new_fact: Risk ETFs closed higher Friday while USO fell.
stories.new_takeaway: The market tone was relief, but not enough to remove rate and inflation pressure.
stories.why_now: Markets were closed Sunday, so Friday's close is the latest tradable signal.
stories.previous_coverage: Markets are covered daily but compactly.
stories.uncertainty: ETF quotes and market pages update dynamically.
stories.watch: Fed meeting, oil risk, and Treasury-yield reaction.

stories.new_fact: The Columbus forecast called for warm, breezy Sunday conditions with a thunderstorm in spots and a less humid Monday.
stories.new_takeaway: Sunday evening plans need radar awareness; Monday is the cleaner reset day.
stories.why_now: Weather is time-sensitive for Sunday evening and Monday morning planning.
stories.previous_coverage: Weather is routine daily service content.
stories.uncertainty: Forecasts update hourly and storm placement is localized.
stories.watch: Radar, wind/hail/downpour risk, and Monday commute conditions.
